known_limits: A repository-level opencode.json in the working tree still contributes MCP entries; OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR only drops the operator's global OpenCode config. That is project configuration, not unrelated user configuration.

The opencode session listing shape was observed only in its empty form on opencode 1.4.3, so parseOssSessionListing accepts either a bare array or a { sessions: [...] } envelope and returns undefined rather than guessing.
A tmux OSS pane relies on OpenCode's own credential lookup or the inherited environment; a provider key is never placed into tmux argv.
